output.reason: The computed schema diff between [ev-782bc47d120d] (v2.6.4) and [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] (v2.7.0) makes `digest` a required property of the `status.artifact` object in the v1beta2 HelmRepository schema. A nested `required` constraint only applies when the parent object exists. The proposed condition (`digest` unset) also matches every HelmRepository that has no `status.artifact` at all, which includes ordinary manifests with no status, and none of those is rejected. Exposure should therefore require `status.artifact` set and `status.artifact.digest` unset. Note that known fact vf-a5cc22f29e7f records this same change with the same broader condition.

correction.statement: In the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 HelmRepository schema, status.artifact.digest is now required. A HelmRepository whose status.artifact is set without a digest is rejected; objects with no status.artifact are not affected.
